cc:Work.dc:title: RevCT architecture and training protocol
cc:Work.dc:description: RevCT architecture. HU-valued chest CT NIfTI is reoriented to RAS, resampled to 2 mm, clamped and scaled, then centre cropped or padded to 192 cubed voxels. The frozen COLIPRI image encoder uses a Primus/EVA backbone, channel projection, then attention pooling. Its 768-D image features are not L2 normalised and are rounded through fp16 before fp32 head inference. Training-fitted standardisation feeds 18 logistic heads. Raw logits independently feed a training-selected F1 bias comparison for decisions and sigmoid then isotonic maps for scores. Typed records include decision, score and confidence. A separate training-only strip shows out-of-fold fitting of decision biases and calibrators and final head refitting.
